{{Quote|Following the destruction of the Death Star, Willard coordinated the less-renowned yet still crucial Battle of Shaylin 18 ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]]|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
'''Shaylin 18''' was a celestial body<ref name="AIR" /> located in the [[Shaylin system/Legends|Shaylin system]], a part of the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]] linked it to the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni]] and [[Turkana system/Legends|Turkana systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', which establishes that the [[Battle of Shaylin 18]] took place following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since ''The New Essential Chronology'' also establishes the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] immediately succeeding the Battle of Yavin as [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Battle of Shaylin 18 must have occurred at some point between those two dates.</ref> the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fought the [[Battle of Shaylin 18]] there.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaylin 18 was mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shaylin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Shaylin 18, in grid square T-6. In one map of the book, the system was erroneously placed near the south edge of the grid square,<ref name="TEA" /> in territory that fell within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] instead of the Pakuuni [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
